newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ROCHE, AKZO UNIT SETTLE DISPUTE.
newsitem.headline: ROCHE, AKZO UNIT SETTLE DISPUTE.

text.p: Swiss pharmaceuticals group Roche Holding AG said it and Organon Teknika BV, a unit of Dutch chemicals group Akzo Nobel NV, had signed a worldwide settlement agreement ending several patent disputes that had led to lawsuits in Europe and the United States.

At the heart of the dispute was whether Organon Teknika's development of diagnostics products using an RNA-transcription-based gene amplification system infringed on Roche's basic Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) patents on gene amplification.

"As a result of this settlement, both companies have agreed that Organon Teknika may practise its NASBA RNA transcription-based amplification. All other associated patent disputes have also been resolved, and therefore, all pending litigation is being terminated," Roche said in a statement.
